Product Details: The Freeman PE20V31618G 20 Volt Cordless 3-in-1 16-Gauge and 18-Gauge Nailer / Stapler Kit with Lithium Ion Battery, Charger, Bag, and Fasteners (600 Count) can drive up to 1300 fasteners per charge and 90 pieces per minute, and is powered by a high-capacity rechargeable 20 volt 2.0 Ah lithium-ion battery. The cordless electric design eliminates the need to be tethered to a loud and heavy air compressor, improving mobility around the house or jobsite. A 3-in-1 multi-purpose magazine allows both nailing and stapling with just one tool and is ideal for crown moulding, base boards, window casings, chair rails, furniture, cabinetry, and other finish projects. Use the select fire button to toggle fast and easy between single sequential firing for precision or bump firing for speed. The depth of the fasteners is adjusted by simply turning a wheel near the drive blade, and a quick jam release provides easy access clearing in the event of a jammed fastener. A no mar tip protects your work surface, ensuring professional results for DIYers as well as construction contractors. This cordless finish nailer comes with everything you need to get right to work, including a 20 volt 2.0 Ah lithium-ion battery, rapid charger, canvas bag, belt hook, and fasteners. The 20 Volt Cordless 3-in-1 16-Gauge and 18-Gauge Nailer / Stapler Kit will significantly increase your productivity when tackling home improvement and repair projects, and is covered by Freeman's 1 Year Professional Tool Warranty.
